# Technical blog workflow — GitHub Copilot

When asked to start, resume, or continue a technical blog, read `AGENTS.md`, `harness/adapters/copilot.md`, and `harness/contracts/host-capabilities.md`, then follow the shared manifest/workflow/policies and saved-state startup protocol.

Use only the active Copilot surface's real tools and MCP connections. This workflow requires an interactive human review loop; pause if the current surface cannot obtain replies or execute the local helpers. Do not infer approvals from an unattended task, tool permissions or PR creation. Never stage/commit `outputs/`, force-add ignored artifacts, bypass source request permits or invent remote deliverables. Merely loading this file does not start collection, and unrelated coding requests should not start the blog workflow.
